full_judgment: 2. The decision proposed to be given in this civil Revision petition does not demand a detailed recounting of facts except that sole opposite party No.1 of this Civil Revision petition as sole plaintiff laid a suit being Title suit No. 326 of 1982 in First Court of Munsif, Dhaka for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession with respect to property described in schedule to the plaint. The said suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 226 of 1985 on transfer to the Second Court of Assistant Judge Dhaka.
